title: 대수기하학 원론 (EGA) — 한국어 누적판 / Éléments de géométrie algébrique — Korean Cumulative Edition
description:
Éléments de géométrie algébrique — Korean Cumulative Edition (대수기하학 원론 (EGA) — 한국어 누적판), release 2026-09-06-r39.

This front-facing cumulative reader preserves every Korean EGA unit admitted by exact source, translation, typesetting and deterministic QA gates. It contains complete Korean EGA 0_I and EGA I; the complete EGA II Chapter II programme/table of contents; and contiguous EGA II main text through §2.2.6, canonical French source ega2-1-fr.tex lines 1–1780. EGA II and the complete corpus remain incomplete. Work resumes after blank line 1781 at line 1782, environment 2.2.7. No corpus-completion, finality, infallibility, perfection or external-certification claim is made.

The stable edition DOI 10.5281/zenodo.21921513 identifies the evolving Korean lineage; exact DOI 10.5281/zenodo.22416007 identifies this immutable checkpoint. Working repository: github.com/KokunoYumeto/ega-ko. Preceding r38 DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.22346664.

R39 translates Lemma 2.2.2 and proof, environment 2.2.3, Lemma 2.2.4 and proof, Proposition 2.2.5 and proof, and Corollary 2.2.6 and proof, lines 1685–1780. It covers positive-degree localization identifications; ring and module maps from S_(f) and M_(f) to their fg counterparts; the commutative triangle; generation by two canonical images; a quotient-isomorphism inverse; and the positive-degree Noetherian conclusion. Controls bind 74 inline formulas, 3 displays, one xymatrix, five labels, six references, nine environment events, marker II|25, and 17 contiguous semantic clauses. Source oddities at lines 1709 and 1738 remain diplomatic and were reported without silently changing French.

The exact source slice is 3,796 LF-terminal UTF-8 bytes / 3,740 characters / SHA-256 BE7EC704F82B9283A48AFF1A01D7CF34F14A2C29F1B50269511DD699514BBC21; the canonical prefix is 81,885 bytes / 033E312D8BD9E22AEC1D5B8AC5705ED71C64C4E4DCFBB7ED84B9A434313ACE33; the Korean candidate is 4,051 bytes / E8F52EDEC11B90D3CCC4E2398279DA4DEA7A6064AABFBE87D1765D55FEDE1940. The cumulative Korean EGA II target is 84,274 bytes / 59D07958D5CE1765F4901202CE97B3AC6257F6DC6C0D114C37B314C6A6EB1943. Its exact nine-locus terminology reseal uses 동차 아이디얼/동차 소아이디얼 for homogeneous ideals while retaining 등급 for graded structures. Formulae, TeX-command order, non-Hangul projection, bytes, characters and lines remain unchanged; reverse reconstruction passes.

The cumulative PDF has 240 pages / 1,491,216 bytes / SHA-256 AB24AAA5A4FBEAC3528892EF998C93276BF6DD38E7520C5F18A316E3FBAEAA6F and 229 historical printed-page markers. Two independent clean four-pass XeLaTeX cycles were run under the machine-wide mutex; passes 3–4 converged within each cycle and both finals are byte-identical. Checks cover all 17 Korean inputs and 23 canonical inputs, two independent extractions, every marker, destinations, links, A4 structure, embedded fonts and Hangul ToUnicode. Thirteen selected 300-dpi pages, including every detected R39 page and both terminology loci, showed no observed clipping, overlap, tofu, damaged formula/diagram or unreadable text. Legacy Type1 mathematics extraction is not lossless; editable TeX and rendered formulae remain authoritative. These hard checks establish only the tested properties.
